label: Skierniewice: split on the Łódź/Masovian line
why: Skierniewice's zone (skw) is two NUTS-3 subregions in two voivodeships: Skierniewicki (Łódź voivodeship, 0.36M) and Żyrardowski (Masovian, 0.27M), the only Polish zone across a voivodeship line. Żyrardowski (Żyrardów, Grodzisk Mazowiecki, Sochaczew) joins Warsaw's metro, whose western ring it continues; Skierniewicki, at 72% of the floor too small to stand alone, joins Łódź's metro on its own side of the line.
